title: Indicators
subtitle: Every indicator's target, actual and the source of each number, in one table.

empty.title: No indicators yet
empty.body: Add the indicators from your project document; the quarters are ready. You can set up the logframe first and add indicators under its outputs.

table.proposed: {count, plural, one {# value waits} other {# values wait}} for approval
table.footnote: Each cell shows the actual on top and the target below. In an ended period, below 90% of target shows in amber. To date compares with the target up to the last period that has a value.

form.title: New indicator
form.description: Write it as in the project document. You enter targets and values period by period later.
form.namePlaceholder: e.g. Number of children referred to education
form.numberError: Baseline and LoP target must be numbers (e.g. 1,250 or 12.5).
form.cumulativeOn: Period values add up: 120 in Q1 and 80 in Q2 make 200 to date.
form.cumulativeOff: The latest period's value counts, like a rate or a level.
form.disaggregationHint: Totals only; one total per group (e.g. Girls: 140).
form.definitionPlaceholder: What do we count, and how? Who is included and who is not?
form.movPlaceholder: e.g. Quarterly reports, school enrolment records
form.totalsOnly: No field holds information about one child; totals only.

periods.title: Reporting periods
periods.description: The columns of the IPTT and the periods reports cover.
periods.othersNote: Not shown in the table; used for reports and files.
periods.label: Name
periods.layoutHint: If the project year starts mid-year, start the quarters in that month (Y1 Q1, Y1 Q2…). Targets already entered are removed.
periods.layoutLocked: Values are recorded in the quarters, so the layout no longer changes. You can still edit them one by one.

read.title: Read values from a report
read.description: Pick a partner report. Claude finds the indicator totals in it with their pages, and you approve each one.
read.done: {title} is read. The values found wait for your approval.

chart.proposed: {count, plural, one {# value waits} other {# values wait}} for approval
chart.empty: The chart appears once there is a target or a value.

value.title: Add value
value.numberError: That is not a number. Write it like 1,250 or 12.5.
value.percentError: A percentage must be between 0 and 100.
value.groupsHint: Leave empty for the overall total. For one group's total, type the group; add each group separately for the same period.
value.notePlaceholder: e.g. Table 3, the field team's quarterly total
value.totalsOnly: Totals only. Do not write names, ID numbers or anything about one child.
value.savedCount: {count, plural, one {# value saved} other {# values saved}}

values.approvedMany: {count, plural, one {# value} other {# values}} approved.

explain.title: Why is it behind?
explain.footnote: Claude's draft, from the linked meetings, notes and files only. Check it and edit as needed.
explain.saved: The explanation is saved as a note.

statusLine.on_track: At {pct} of the target to date, on track.
statusLine.behind: At {pct} of the target to date, below 90%.
statusLine.ahead: At {pct} of the target to date, ahead.
statusLine.no_data: The status shows here once there is a target or a value.

page.lopHint: The target for the whole project
page.baselineHint: The value at the start of the project
page.waiting: {count, plural, one {# value waits} other {# values wait}} for approval
page.spread: Spread the LoP target over periods
page.noValues: No values yet. Enter a total from a partner report with "Add value".
page.noValuesAi: No values yet. Enter one with "Add value", or let Claude read a report with "Read values from a report" on the Indicators screen.

logframe.title: Logframe
logframe.subtitle: The goal, outcomes and outputs, each with its indicators and activities.
logframe.summary: {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {indicators, plural, one {# indicator} other {# indicators}}
logframe.addDescription: Write the statement as in the project document.

placeholders.goal: e.g. Contribute to reducing child labour in seasonal agriculture
placeholders.outcome: e.g. Children in target provinces have better access to education
placeholders.output: e.g. Summer schools and temporary learning spaces are set up

logframe.looseActivities: {count, plural, one {# activity is} other {# activities are}} not linked to an output.

empty.title: Set up your logframe
empty.body: Add the goal, outcomes and outputs from the project document. Indicators and workplan activities gather under them.
